text: Hey, quick question—if we want to send out a new onboarding email series for customers, do we need to get it reviewed outside our team? Or can we just adapt the stuff from the last campaign and send it out?

Yeah, Mei, we do need to get it reviewed. Even if you’re adapting stuff from the last campaign, it still has to go through the content review process. There’s a whole thing in the handbook about this—something like, any new or adapted content needs to be checked for accuracy and style, not just by us.
Ah, got it. Do you know how long that usually takes? We’re hoping to get this out before the end of the month.
It’s usually about 10 working days, give or take. They call it a milestone in the policy. So I’d plan for at least two weeks for the full review, just to be safe.
Okay, thanks Jake! I’ll factor that into the timeline. I’ll check the handbook page for the steps too.
